Layout hoverlabel objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_hoverlabel.Rd

Properties of layout.hoverlabel.

Usage

go_layout_hoverlabel(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  align = NULL,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  bordercolor = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  grouptitlefont = NULL,
  namelength = NULL,
  showarrow = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_hoverlabel_font(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  family = NULL,
  lineposition = NULL,
  shadow = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  textcase = NULL,
  variant = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_hoverlabel_grouptitlefont(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  family = NULL,
  lineposition = NULL,
  shadow = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  textcase = NULL,
  variant = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

align

Sets the horizontal alignment of the text content within hover label box. Has an effect only if the hover label text spans two or more lines One of "left", "right", "auto".

bgcolor

Sets the background color of all hover labels on graph Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

bordercolor

Sets the border color of all hover labels on graph. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

font

Sets the default hover label font used by all traces on the graph. Named list or go_layout_hoverlabel_font() object.

grouptitlefont

Sets the font for group titles in hover (unified modes). Defaults to `hoverlabel.font`. Named list or go_layout_hoverlabel_grouptitlefont() object.

namelength

Sets the default length (in number of characters) of the trace name in the hover labels for all traces. -1 shows the whole name regardless of length. 0-3 shows the first 0-3 characters, and an integer >3 will show the whole name if it is less than that many characters, but if it is longer, will truncate to `namelength - 3` characters and add an ellipsis. Integer in the interval [-1, Inf].

showarrow

Sets whether or not to show the hover label arrow/triangle pointing to the data point. Logical.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

color

Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

family

HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String.

lineposition

Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none".

shadow

Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String.

size

Number in the interval [1, Inf].

style

Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic".

textcase

Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower".

variant

Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase".

weight

Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000].

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_hoverlabel() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

Nested objects documented here:

go_layout_hoverlabel_font()

layout.hoverlabel.font: Sets the default hover label font used by all traces on the graph.

go_layout_hoverlabel_grouptitlefont()

layout.hoverlabel.grouptitlefont: Sets the font for group titles in hover (unified modes). Defaults to `hoverlabel.font`.

See also

go_layout()
